name: Grace
label: woman · 30s · soft, soothing bedtime
description: A woman in her thirties with a very soft, soothing, gentle voice. Slow and relaxed, calm breathing, perfect for bedtime stories and meditation. Quiet and tender.
ref_text: The old house at the end of the lane had stood empty for many years. Each autumn, the leaves gathered on its steps, and the village children wondered who had lived there, and why they had never come back.
